title: Qatar GDELT tone leads TTF/HH ratio
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Qatar GDELT tone 20d z-score < -1 (worsening Gulf news) leads the TTF to Henry Hub ratio by 2 days (+); trade long TTF=F 5d [gdelt.qat.tone -> finance.ratio.ttf_henryhub]
message: Not supported: Qatar tone vs TTF/HH ratio r=-0.10 (n=390, best lag -1d); z>1 long rule 51 trades hit 63% excess +0.25%/trade actionability 7.4 but contradicts negative correlation - treat as fragile

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.qat.tone rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ratio:ttf_henryhub next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
